_comment: Exposure defaults in microseconds per objective, at 1x full resolution (this rig always runs 1x) under tungsten illumination. 5x=40ms and 20x=45ms MEASURED 2026-07-07 (nearly flat — per-objective NA compensates for magnification); 10x interpolated between them; 50x/100x scaled from the 20x measurement by the old inter-mag ratios — trim these when measured (edits apply live on mag change). wb: manual Red/Blue BalanceRatio defaults for the tungsten illuminator, tuned 2026-07-07.
